advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence identifies no distinct, well-specified cache-blocking experiment for this role: the 32-row panel call was already tested and showed no repeatable gain, while the 64×32 traversal is already in the full512 kernel. The other proposed panel-pack design changes layout, packing, and traversal together and is not an independently established cache improvement. Avoid resubmitting a duplicate or claiming a cache bottleneck without evidence.
risks: No new experiment is proposed. Existing measurements do not identify the limiting resource or establish that a different blocking scheme would improve throughput; all recorded scores remain below 1800 GFLOP/s.
